_what_this_is: Result of running the CLAUDE.md §5.3 citation validator, exactly as specified, over the round-2 interpretation card. Run via a throwaway verification harness (NOT src/ pipeline code — no pipeline code is written pre-sign-off).
validator_rule_as_specified: For each hop citation: PASS if the cited fact's `metric` or any `entities` slug appears in (or is a dictionary-alias of) the hop's `from`/`to` nodes or mechanism text. FAIL -> strip to [] and record a warning.

round_2_card.verdict: PASS — zero citation-integrity violations, satisfying the Phase 0 gate criterion.

round_1_regression_test.test: Re-inject the round-1 failure — cite facts 105 and 116 (Brent PRICE prints) on the hop 'brent_crude_price -> india_crude_import_bill' whose mechanism claims India imports ~85% of its crude.
round_1_regression_test.verdict: FAIL — the specified validator CANNOT catch the failure class it was designed for. See BUILD_NOTES F7 (critical).
root_cause: The hop's `from` node is, by construction, the topic of the fact being cited. Here from = 'brent_crude_price' and the cited fact's metric is literally 'brent_crude_price', so the overlap test passes trivially.

Even if the `from` node were excluded from matching, the token 'crude' is shared between the fact metric 'brent_crude_price' and the to-node 'india_crude_import_bill', so a token-overlap test still passes.
The violation is semantic — whether the fact evidences the RELATIONSHIP asserted — which token overlap on node names cannot express.

detection_power_probe.test: Cite fact 124 (us_10y_yield) on the Strait of Hormuz supply hop — a gross topical mismatch.
detection_power_probe.verdict: The validator does work for gross, unrelated-topic mismatches. Its blind spot is specifically the ADJACENT-topic case, which is the compliance-relevant one.

conclusion: In round 2 the citation integrity was achieved by the PROMPT (S6 correctly emitted fact_ids: [] on the import-dependency hop), not by the validator. The validator is currently a weak backstop that catches only unrelated-topic citations. Treat prompt discipline as the primary control until F7 is resolved.
